summary: This MA is for students leaving the PhD. You need at least 46 graduate units (the program minimum the Bulletin lists; the overview says 45), every course letter graded where a letter grade is offered, the requirements of your subplan, a 3.0 GPA and one quarter as a TA. Environmental Behavioral Science asks for the theory and methods cores (COMM 318 for 5 units), four Advanced Theory courses totaling 10 units, one data, one ecology and one advanced methods course, two quarters of EBS 298 and six of EBS 300. Global Environmental Policy asks for one causal inference sequence (ECON or POLISCI), CS 229 and a 200-level CS deep learning course, GEP 268 and 269, the economics sequence, the four policy courses (GEP 215, 305, 347 and 365) and GEP 300, plus a science or engineering sequence and open electives you choose with your advisor, five courses in all with one of the two sequences at three. Your advisor confirms the deep learning course, the sequences, the GPA, the TAship, the research plan and the annual reviews.
